Course Information

Cognos TM1 is a tool provided by IBM. It falls under the Business Intelligence and Analysis department. It was formerly known as Applix TM1. It helps users to implement planning budgeting and forecasting solutions required for the firm, while collaborating with all the employees and stake holders. It is also capable of providing analysis on the data and producing reports.

Cognos TM1 is one of the tools used in the field of Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing. As mentioned earlier, it helps in analysing and forecasting data. This constitutes the important tasks in the procedure. Learning about the tools that help users to finish the tasks in a simple and effective fashion is what anyone wishes to achieve.

The data stored in Cognos TM1 is of the multi-dimensional OLAP cube format with all the data getting stored in the lower leaf level. All the computations that are performed on the data in the leaf level are done in real time.

Who Can Take This Course?

Cognos TM1 is a web-based, integrated business intelligence suite given by IBM. It programs in the software platforms. Business Intelligence has been at extremely the first stage in the greater part of the corporate. It has bright scope in great organizations. Following professionals can go to this:

  • Software developers
  • IT Experts
  • Fresher’s
  • BI / ETL Professionals

Prerequisites?

It is an advancement over the IBM’s Cognos tool. All that the individual who wishes to learn about Cognos needs is the interest, passion and dedication to learn.

Anyone can take this with basic Knowledge of SQL and Computer usage skills. Other than no particular prerequisites are not required. The trainer will help you on the basics and keys those are required.
